text:
maria_support: FYI — customer ZenWorks (acct ZW-77) opened ticket CS-2189. Their invoice 94021 (PDF attached) is missing the PO number after we applied the VAT correction yesterday. They need a corrected invoice with PO before reconciliation tomorrow morning. Can finance advise if we can reissue or if we must credit+rebill? cc @john_billing

john_billing: Do we know whether payment has already been captured? If it's captured we usually need to issue a credit note and create a new invoice with the PO.

maria_support: Payment was captured on 2026-03-15 via card (last4 4242), amount 18,400.00 EUR. Customer is insisting they need the PO on the invoice for their AP system to accept it.

kevin_engineer: quick note — I noticed a portal sanitizer changed long strings during the VAT change process. PO field seems to be trimmed to 0 chars if it contains "#" or slashes. Might be related. :thinking:

maria_support: attaching the PDF they provided and the portal export: zenworks_invoice_94021.pdf, portal_export_94021.json

accounting_bot: automated-update: invoice 94021 status = paid, tax_adjustment = true, credit_notes = 0

john_billing: Thanks. Given status=paid we can't edit the original invoice. Proposed flow: 1) issue a full credit note for 94021, 2) create new invoice 94021-R1 with PO number embedded, 3) link credit note to original payment in ledger, 4) refund or apply credit depending on customer's preference.

ella_ops: Also confirm entity and tax lines before reissuing — VAT jurisdiction changed during the correction and we need the same tax breakdown to avoid misreporting. Finance, please confirm the tax code to use for the new invoice.

kevin_engineer: As an interim customer-facing workaround we can generate a PDF overlay that puts the PO on the top-right and upload as "official invoice copy" while finance processes the credit+rebill. Not ideal but buys time.

john_billing: Agree. Customer choice: (A) credit+rebill (preferred for audit) or (B) provisional PO-overlay + later official rebill. Ask customer which they want. If they pick (A) we need approval to void and reissue.

maria_support: pinged customer asking if they accept credit+rebill or need provisional. I included standard consent checkbox copy and asked for confirmation to proceed.

accounting_bot: note: creating credit_note will create GL entry CN-2026-778. Notify legal if cross-border VAT reversal required.

john_billing: Action items: 1) maria_support wait for customer consent, 2) finance to prepare credit note template and new invoice draft with PO field populated, 3) kevin_engineer to patch portal sanitizer for PO char set and queue hotfix to avoid recurrence. I'll own the ledger entries and refunds.

maria_support: Received customer acknowledgement: they want credit+rebill. "Please reissue with PO ZW-PO-3321 and apply to original payment." Forwarding their exact wording. :white_check_mark:

john_billing: OK. I'll start CN creation. ETA 2 business days for credit note + new invoice generation. tagging @ella_ops for VAT line confirmation.

ella_ops: Confirmed tax lines — use VAT-23-EU as per original region. Finance proceed.

kevin_engineer: Filed bug #INF-4721 to prevent future PO truncations. I'll include the overlay endpoint so support can upload provisional PDFs until fix.

maria_support: Closing loop with customer now, will update ticket CS-2189 when CN-2026-778 and invoice 94021-R1 are issued. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
